title: Passing Rate for Private Hire Driver Vocational Licence Test
what_it_is: Passing Rate for Private Hire Driver Vocational Licence Test

sections.label: English requirement for PHC drivers
sections.summary: PHC drivers must read and speak simple English, so the PDVL course and test are conducted in English with no plans for other languages.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Private hire car (PHC) drivers must be able to read and speak simple English.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: This also ensures that the drivers can communicate effectively with all commuters, both Singaporeans and tourists.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: This is why the PDVL course and test are conducted in English.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: There are no plans to conduct the tests in other languages.

sections.label: LTA help for PDVL applicants
sections.summary: For longer-term contracts, the Land Transport Authority and agencies work with applying drivers to see what remediation can help them obtain the PDVL.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: As for longer-term contracts, the Land Transport Authority and the agencies do work with the drivers who are applying, to help try to see what is the remediation that can be applied to help them obtain the PDVL.

sections.label: Residents in those situations
sections.summary: The speaker says some residents are in those situations, and that the matter needs to be studied and will be.

sentences.speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
sentences.text: I ask this because I actually have some residents who are in those situations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: I need to study the matter and I will do so.
